item_short_desc: Rothco’s Full-Finger Rappelling Gloves offer the ultimate in protection and durability for public safety professionals and tactical enthusiasts alike. Designed with rugged cowhide leather, these gloves provide a strong yet flexible barrier, perfect for rappelling and other high-demand tasks. The padded knuckles, thumb, and fingers shield your hands from debris and impacts, while reinforced palms ensure long-lasting use during intense activities.
description: Rothco’s Full-Finger Rappelling Gloves offer the ultimate in protection and durability for public safety professionals and tactical enthusiasts alike. Designed with rugged cowhide leather, these gloves provide a strong yet flexible barrier, perfect for rappelling and other high-demand tasks. The padded knuckles, thumb, and fingers shield your hands from debris and impacts, while reinforced palms ensure long-lasting use during intense activities. The gloves' full-finger design offers superior protection while maintaining dexterity for precision tasks. For a secure fit, a hook & loop closure keeps the gloves firmly in place throughout any operation. Whether you’re rappelling, climbing, or performing other physically demanding tasks, Rothco’s Full-Finger Rappelling Gloves are built to handle the challenge, ensuring comfort and protection in the field.
